tool_config.name: report_incident
tool_config.description: Record one municipal service issue for human review. Never approves or dispatches. Read the returned reference number back exactly.

turn_id.description: A stable request identifier for this logical tool operation. Reuse it unchanged if retrying. Do not reuse it for different information.

description.description: What happened, in the resident own words, 10 to 4000 characters.

area.description: Area, landmark or street supplied by the resident; at most 200 characters. Never infer a verified location.

language.description: Resident language code: en or af.

channel.description: phone for a telephone call; chat for widget or text chat.

contact_preference.description: none, email, or voice as explicitly selected by resident.

contact_email.description: Optional resident email only after consent. Do not require contact details.

contact_phone.description: Optional callback phone only after consent. Never take system caller ID as consent.

consent_to_contact.description: True only after explicit resident consent to contact.

callback_consent.description: True only after explicit consent to an outbound voice callback.

privacy_consent_accepted.description: True only after the resident explicitly accepts municipal processing of this report to assess, route and manage the service issue. Read the purpose and ask first. Contact consent is separate.

privacy_consent_version.description: civicops-popia-v1 only after explicit acceptance of the current service-report privacy purpose.
